controls.title: Require multi-factor authentication
controls.statement: Require multi-factor authentication for remote, privileged and other high-risk human access, and prevent alternate sign-in paths from bypassing it.
controls.risk: A stolen password could give an attacker access to sensitive information or important systems if no independent identity check is required.
controls.scope: Human access to remote services, privileged functions, critical systems and other access identified as high risk.
controls.examine: Compare users, systems and access paths with authentication policies, technical enforcement, exclusions and sign-in records.
controls.interview: Ask identity and service owners how high-risk access is identified, how exceptions are approved and how new access paths are brought into scope.
controls.test: Use authorised test accounts to sign in through primary, recovery and alternate paths. Verify that the required factors are enforced and cannot be bypassed.
controls.expected: Each in-scope access path requires the prescribed independent factors; unsupported systems and approved exceptions are recorded and reviewed.

controls.title: Protect and monitor authentication factors
controls.statement: Protect factor enrolment and secret material, and centrally monitor successful and unsuccessful multi-factor authentication events.
controls.risk: Attackers could register their own factor or abuse authentication failures without being detected, defeating the protection expected from multi-factor authentication.
controls.scope: Factor enrolment, authenticator secrets, multi-factor authentication services and their security events.
controls.examine: Inspect enrolment controls, cryptographic protection, event collection, alert rules and investigations of suspicious authentication activity.
controls.interview: Ask identity operators how factor changes are authorised and how unusual enrolment or authentication activity is investigated.
controls.test: Perform an authorised factor enrolment and successful and failed sign-ins. Trace approval, protected secret handling and complete events into central monitoring.
controls.expected: Factor enrolment is authorised, authenticator secrets use approved protection, and relevant authentication events reach monitoring with enough detail for investigation.

mappings.basis: Requires approved cryptography when establishing multi-factor OTP keys and secrets.
